subject: Post-call: RetailCo model-fit follow-up — regression after update
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tim Nguyen <tim.nguyen@retailco.com>, Ava Retail <ava.retail@retailco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: RetailCo model-fit follow-up — recommended next steps

Thanks again for taking the call today — great context on the product search and catalog normalization goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Goal: Improve recall on long-tail SKUs while keeping hallucination rate <1%.
- Current infra: Dedicated pool (retailco-123), currently pinned to redwood/optima-7b-v2 historically.
- Recommendation: Run a focused eval on the 2K prompt set we discussed (attached) comparing optima-7b-v2, optima-7b-v3, and an instruction-tuned 13B variant for the high-precision path.

Attachments: prompt_set_v3.txt (prompt samples + expected outputs), benchmark_results.csv (baseline results).

Next steps
1) RetailCo to run the baseline eval we attached (or we can run it on your behalf) — Tim/Ava, what works best?
2) We'll share suggested inference knobs (temperature, top_p, stop conditions) and a quick MATT test script to reproduce metrics.
3) If you see regressions after a model refresh, we can pin to a prior version and open a rollback.

Happy to schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to review results.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[attachment: prompt_set_v3.txt (text)]

From: Tim Nguyen <tim.nguyen@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Retail <ava.retail@retailco.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: RetailCo model-fit follow-up — recommended next steps

Marissa — thanks for the recap. We ran the eval overnight (using your prompt_set_v3) and saw a surprising drop in precision when you rolled to optima-7b-v3 yesterday. Examples attached.

Short summary:
- top-1 accuracy on long-tail SKU lookup dropped from 87.2% -> 76.9%
- hallucination examples attached in benchmark_results.csv

We did not change any client-side decoding knobs. Can you confirm whether Redwood pushed an automatic model variant upgrade on our Dedicated pool? If so, we'd like to either roll back to v2 or pin our route until we re-evaluate. This is blocking a demo scheduled next week.

Tim
Senior ML Engineer | RetailCo
[two sample failure cases attached: benchmark_results.csv (csv), example_responses.txt (text)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Nguyen <tim.nguyen@retailco.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Re: Post-call: RetailCo model-fit follow-up — recommended next steps

Rishi/Dev/Sean — forwarding RetailCo's eval results. They observed a clear drop in long-tail precision after the deployment moved their pool to redwood/optima-7b-v3. Tim asked for an immediate rollback/pin. Can we triage: 

- Can engineering confirm whether retailco-123 was auto-upgraded and what change caused the drop?
- If we can rollback, give ETA and any customer-facing caveats.
- If not immediate, propose a short mitigation (pin route to v2, or tune decoding) and I'll communicate to Tim.

I'll hold on telling them our internal plan until we know the ETA. Attaching their csv and our prompt set for context.

Thanks —
Marissa
[attachment: benchmark_results.csv (csv), prompt_set_v3.txt (text)]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Post-call: RetailCo model-fit follow-up — recommended next steps

Quick triage notes:
- Confirmed: retailco-123 experienced an automated model refresh this morning as part of a staged rollout. Pool moved from redwood/optima-7b-v2 -> redwood/optima-7b-v3.
- Root cause signal: a change in the tokenizer normalization + a default decoding parameter (top_p default decreased from 0.95 -> 0.90 in the new runtime profile). Those two changes together explain lower recall and the hallucination pattern.

Immediate remediation (recommended):
1) Roll back retailco-123 to optima-7b-v2 (low risk) — ETA 30 mins, will trigger a brief cache warmup period.
2) Pin the route to optima-7b-v2 for RetailCo by adding a route override (we'll keep the pool health checks active).
3) Produce a small diff and a short RCA doc for the customer. See deployment_diff.patch attached and a quick internal note at https://app.redwood.com/deployments/retailco-123/logs.

If they want to test v3, we recommend running v3 with top_p=0.95 and the previous tokenizer option; we can provide tuned parameters and a test harness.

I'll schedule the rollback now unless you ask otherwise, Marissa.

— Dev
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: deployment_diff.patch (patch)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tim Nguyen <tim.nguyen@retailco.com>, Ava Retail <ava.retail@retailco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: RetailCo model-fit follow-up — rollback complete and next steps

Tim/Ava — quick update: we rolled retailco-123 back to redwood/optima-7b-v2 and pinned your route to that version. Dev's team confirmed the rollback completed at 08:40 PST this morning.

What we did:
- Rolled back to optima-7b-v2 and pinned the route (no further automatic refreshes).
- Confirmed post-rollback evals on a sample subset show top-1 accuracy back to 87.1%. See rollback_confirmation.txt attached.
- Documented the runtime change that caused the shift (tokenizer normalizer + top_p default) and included deployment_diff.patch.

Next steps:
1) We'll run a full 2K eval overnight and share the full CSV by EOD Monday.
2) If you want to test v3 with tuned params, we can run a canary for you and share config suggestions (top_p=0.95 + previous tokenizer).
3) I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Tue Nov 17 to review results and decide on long-term pin vs upgrade path.

Apologies for the disruption — we'll make sure you have a watertight plan for upgrades going forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[attachment: rollback_confirmation.txt (text), benchmark_results.csv (csv)]
